{{CharInfobox |text=White |color={{black color}} |corecolor={{cologne color dark}} |bordercolor={{black color dark}} |name=Astrid |jname=アヤカ |tmname=Ayaka |image=Astrid.png |size=135px |caption=Astrid |colors=yes |eyes=Lavender |hair=Blonde |gender=Female |trainerclass={{tc|Ace Trainer}} |hometown=Unknown |region=[[Kalos]] |anime=yes |epnum=XYS01 |epname=Mega Evolution Special I |enva=[[Kate Bristol]] |java=[[Miyuu Sawai]] }} '''Astrid''' (Japanese: '''アヤカ''' ''Ayaka'') is a minor recurring character in {{aniseries|XY}}. She is a skilled {{pkmn|Trainer}} who possesses a [[Key Stone]] and an [[Absolite]]. She wears her Key Stone as an earring on her right ear. ==In animation== Astrid debuted in ''[[XYS01|Mega Evolution Special I]]''. She met up with [[Alain]] and started a battle with him. When Alain sent out his {{TP|Alain|Charizard}}, she noticed it wore a Mega Stone around its neck. Before Astrid sent out her Pokémon, she asked Alain for his name and then introduced herself. She sent out her {{p|Absol}}, which she considers to be her strongest Pokémon. After having Charizard block an attack, Alain complimented Astrid on her Absol. After this, he proposed to show each other's true power, and they proceeded to Mega Evolve their Pokémon. [[File:Astrid Key Stone.png|thumb|left|250px|Astrid's Key Stone]] Even though Mega Absol managed to hold on for a while by blocking Mega Charizard X's attacks, it proved to be no match for its sheer power. Astrid congratulated her Mega Absol after it managed to withstand a powerful {{m|Dragon Claw}} and a {{m|Flamethrower}}. When Astrid had Mega Absol use {{m|Dark Pulse}}, Alain had his Mega Charizard X counter it with a {{m|Blast Burn}}. This proved to be too much for Mega Absol, who fell down and reverted to its regular form, defeated. Even though it lost, Astrid reassured her Absol it fought well. Afterwards she was approached by Alain, who hoped to fight her once again in the future. In ''[[M17|Diancie and the Cocoon of Destruction]]'', Astrid battled {{Ash}} at [[Avignon Town]]. After a fierce match, she won the battle using her Mega Absol. Afterwards, {{an|Bonnie}} tried to ask her to marry {{an|Clemont}}, but was quickly pulled away by her embarrassed big brother. In ''[[XY125|A League of His Own!]]'', Astrid competed in the [[Lumiose Conference]]. During the opening reception, she was shown talking with [[Titus]] and [[Remo]]. At the end of the episode, she was shown to have won her first battle and advanced to the second round. In ''[[XY126|Valuable Experience for All!]]'', she managed to reach the quarterfinals, where she was pitted against Ash for their second battle. She was defeated by him, however, after his Hawlucha managed to avoid a Psycho Cut and strike down Mega Absol with a decisive Flying Press, placing her in the Top 8. ===Pokémon=== This listing is of Astrid's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}: {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Astrid |pkmn=Absol |mega=yes |type1=Dark |img=Astrid Absol.png |cap=Astrid's Absol |img_size=200px |img2=Astrid Mega Absol.png |cap2=Astrid's Mega Absol |epnum=XYS01 |epname=Mega Evolution Special I |vajp=Hitomi Nabatame |vaen=Bill Rogers |desc={{p|Absol}} is Astrid's main Pokémon. It is able to Mega Evolve into Mega Absol with the help of Astrid's [[Key Stone]] and the [[Absolite]] it holds. Astrid considers Absol to be her strongest Pokémon. In ''[[XYS01|Mega Evolution Special I]]'', Astrid sent it out to battle [[Alain's Charizard]]. Both Pokémon first blocked each other's attacks, with Alain complimenting Absol for how strong it was. Alain proposed to Astrid to Mega Evolve their Pokémon, and so she did. It quickly became apparent that Mega Absol was no match for Mega Charizard X's sheer power, even though it managed to withstand a {{m|Dragon Claw}} and a {{m|Flamethrower}}. When Mega Absol tried to use Dark Pulse, Alain had his Mega Charizard X quickly counter it with {{m|Blast Burn}}, which completely overwhelmed Mega Absol. It fell down and reverted back to its regular form, defeated. Even though it lost, Astrid reassured Absol it fought well. In ''[[M17|Diancie and the Cocoon of Destruction]]'', Absol was the last Pokémon Astrid used in her battle against {{Ash}}. Ash brought out his {{AP|Hawlucha}} to battle it. Right after it was called out, Astrid Mega Evolved it. Hawlucha attacked with a {{m|High Jump Kick}}, but Mega Absol countered this with Shadow Claw. Hawlucha tried using {{m|Karate Chop}}, but Mega Absol swiftly dodged this and then jumped on the roof of the nearby castle and used Dark Pulse from a distance. This completely overpowered Hawlucha, and he was knocked out. In ''[[XY126|Valuable Experience for All!]]'', Absol competed with its Trainer in the [[Lumiose Conference]]. In one of the rounds, it defeated an {{p|Amoonguss}}. In the quarterfinals, it went up against Ash's Hawlucha once more. It unleashed a Psycho Cut, which was avoided before Absol was defeated by Hawlucha's powerful Flying Press, causing Astrid to be eliminated from the League. Absol's known moves are {{m|Psycho Cut}}, {{m|Megahorn}}, {{m|Dark Pulse}}, and {{m|Shadow Claw}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Astrid |pkmn=Pyroar |type1=Fire |type2=Normal |gender=male |img=Astrid Pyroar.png |img_size=200px |epnum=M17 |epname=Diancie and the Cocoon of Destruction |vajp= |vaen= |desc={{p|Pyroar}} was the first Pokémon Astrid used in her battle against {{Ash}}. He went up against [[Ash's Pikachu]]. Pikachu was able to swiftly dodge Pyroar's Flamethrower and Fire Fang and then used {{m|Electro Ball}}, which knocked Pyroar out. Pyroar's known moves are {{m|Flamethrower}} and {{m|Fire Fang}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Astrid |pkmn=Meowstic |type1=Psychic |gender=female |img=Astrid Meowstic.png |img_size=200px |epnum=M17 |epname=Diancie and the Cocoon of Destruction |vajp= |vaen= |desc={{p|Meowstic}} was the second Pokémon Astrid used in her battle against {{Ash}}. She was pitted against [[Ash's Froakie]]. Meowstic and Froakie rapidly exchanged {{m|Cut}} and Scratch, but neither was able to lay a hit. Ash had Froakie use {{m|Water Pulse}}, which Meowstic dodged. Froakie used another Water Pulse which Meowstic now countered with Charge Beam. The Charge Beam overpowered Froakie's Water Pulse and hit Froakie, knocking it out. Meowstic's known moves are {{m|Scratch}} and {{m|Charge Beam}}.}} ===Achievements=== ====Badges obtained==== This listing is of the [[Badge]]s Astrid has obtained in the [[Kalos]] [[region]]: * At least eight Badges (prior to ''[[XY125|A League of His Own!]]'') ====Pokémon League==== Astrid has competed in the following [[Pokémon League Conference]]s: * [[Lumiose Conference]] - Top 8 (''[[XY126|Valuable Experience for All!]]'') ===Voice actors=== {{vatable|color={{cologne color dark}}|bordercolor={{black color}} |ja=沢井美優 ''[[Miyuu Sawai]]'' |en=[[Kate Bristol]] |fi=Susa Saukko |fr_eu=Élisabeth Guinand |de=Farina Brock |es_la=Susana Moreno |id=Clara Dewanti |es_eu=Unknown voice actress ([[XYS01]])
